title: 第19章 诱人条件世子洛游第20章 捧杀皇子灵媒一族
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: “孟尘！”
“大虞六皇子！”
黑面老者开口，没多余感情。
他手中画的不是别人，正是孟尘的样子。
“六皇子？你是想让我们在这京城中动手？”
“就算报酬不菲，可真如此做，不是要我们都死在这里吗！”
众人闻言，纷纷心神一震。
即便是来自混乱星海中的人，也都眉头蹙起。
他们是不把什么六皇子放在眼里，但这里是京城，若在这里出手，别说那六皇子好不好杀了。
即便真的得手，恐怕也逃不出去。
那齐士府，可不是摆设。
其中随便走出一位强大人物，隔空遥望便可以将他们击杀，敢在皇城中袭杀皇子，那纯粹是找死！
“不是京城，而是秋岚狩猎！”
“到时六皇子会前去，你们无需直接动手，只要暗中趋势那里的兽潮袭击便可。”
“当然，为了万无一失，你们之中若有人敢杀，我身后的大人，赏赐妖丹百枚，或灵丹百枚，黄金一百万两！”
“另外，若是你们之中有人想要定居大虞，可赐一处洞天宝地，美人姬妾任选！”
说着，黑脸老者看向了来自混乱星海的几位邪修。
他知道，这些人逃去混乱星海，过的并不怎么样，相信这样的条件，足以令他们疯狂心动。
秋岚狩猎，本就存在着凶险，那是一处天然秘境，与在京城之中不同。
若真有人在那里杀了六皇子，然后嫁祸给兽潮袭击，就算虞皇事后震怒，那也无法算到其他人的头上。
要怪，只能够怪六皇子气运太弱，没有皇道眷顾。
说直白一点，那就是太废物了。
一个连秋岚狩猎都过不了的废物皇子，死了也没人觉得可惜，自然更配不上这大虞的第一女战神了。
“就这么简单？”
不少人闻言，纷纷松了一口气。
如此要求，那么就简单了。
那秋岚狩猎，并非只有大虞皇朝的势力可以参与，其他势力一样可以进入，去争夺其中的机缘。
历年，陨落在其中的皇朝修士，也不是没有。
别的不说，单单是那秘境中的妖兽，被人狩猎的同时，同样也会反杀进入的人。
人类修士的血肉，对妖兽来说也是诱人的补品。
“简单？”
“一群蠢货……”
content_en:
"Meng Chen!"
"The Sixth Prince of Dayu!"
The black-faced old man spoke without any extra emotion.
The drawing in his hand was none other than Meng Chen's appearance.
"Sixth Prince? Do you want us to take action in the capital?"
"Even if the reward is high, if we really do this, wouldn't we all die here!"
When everyone heard this, they were shocked.
Even the people from the chaotic star sea frowned.
They didn't take the Sixth Prince seriously, but this was the capital. If they took action here, let alone kill the Sixth Prince.
Even if you really succeed, I'm afraid you won't be able to escape.
That Qishi Mansion is not just a decoration.
If a powerful person walks out randomly among them, he can kill them by looking at them from a distance. If he dares to attack and kill the prince in the imperial city, he is simply seeking death!
"It's not the capital, it's Qiulan Hunting!"
"The Sixth Prince will go there then. You don't need to take action directly. You just need to secretly lead the beast tide there to attack."
"Of course, to be sure, if any of you dare to kill, the master behind me will reward you with a hundred demon pills, or a hundred spiritual pills, and one million taels of gold!"
"In addition, if any of you want to settle in Dayu, you can be given a treasured land in the cave where you can choose any beautiful concubine!"
As he said that, the black-faced old man looked at the several evil cultivators from the Chaos Star Sea.
He knew that these people had not lived a very good life after escaping to the Chaos Star Sea. He believed that such conditions were enough to make them crazy.
Qiulan's hunting was inherently dangerous. It was a natural secret, different from the capital city.
If someone really killed the Sixth Prince there and then blamed it on the beast wave attack, even if Emperor Yu was furious afterwards, it would not be blamed on anyone else.
To blame, we can only blame the sixth prince's weak luck and lack of imperial favor.
To put it bluntly, it's such a waste.
A good-for-nothing prince who couldn't even survive Qiulan's hunting, no one felt sorry for him when he died, so naturally he was not worthy of the first female war goddess of Yu.
"Is it that simple?"
Many people breathed a sigh of relief after hearing this.
If you ask for it, then it is simple.
In Qiulan's hunting, not only the forces of the Dayu Dynasty can participate, but other forces can also enter to compete for the opportunities.
Over the years, it is not without imperial monks who have fallen among them.
Not to mention anything else, just the monsters in the secret realm, while being hunted by people, will also kill those who enter.
The flesh and blood of human monks is also an attractive tonic to monsters.
"Easy?"
"A bunch of idiots..."
